frozen_before: New adaptive conflict selector, test harness and test scoring implementation
scientific_question: Can a persistent relation learner reject harmful negative transfer from a previously useful source after receiving out-of-sample feedback in a conflicting unknown-schema family without harming zero-shot compatible-family transfer or old-family retention?
simulator: Exactly the previously frozen relation-transfer generator (basin source, lattice/prism compatible targets, counterphase reversed), but entirely NEW seed cohorts and separate TEST indices. Simulator physics, engineered max-min statistic and engineered sensor names are unchanged; no independent generator.

model.candidate_source: Range-conditioned model trained only on the original first observed feature-key signature.
model.candidate_target: Range-conditioned model fitted on the *current target signature* observations EXCLUDING the latest 4 observed target events.
model.validation: The latest 4 target feedback events rank source vs target by mean smoothed log-likelihood (0.25/category Laplace). Never train target candidate on events used for candidate selection. For fewer than 8 target observations choose source; after 8 choose target if target log likelihood strictly exceeds source, else source.
model.record: Persist all validated observed events, source signature and replayed selected-source counts in a versioned SHA256 checkpoint, no hidden domain labels. No data deletion, automatic default promotion or action acquisition authority.
model.caveats: Exact key signatures automatically partition old and new data: an engineer-given novelty marker, not semantic understanding. One signature with two conflicting regimes remains unsolved. A four-event predictive tail can be misleading under noise.

training_costs: One independent external random simulator first-action observation per TRAIN episode; source and three target streams counted once across methods/checkpoints, separate harmful source actions and read-only TEST harms.
scores: selected source or target by checkpoint
acceptance: At 0 target feedback, gated=source frozen on lattice and prism. On counterphase, gated should improve over frozen source after 8,24 or64 target observations while retaining basin behavior. Compare to target-only and disclose cost/early learning failures. No tuning on additional seeds.
nonclaims: The inverted control is purposely authored with the same features-to-range map, not genuinely unknown physics.
Generator and max-minus-min statistic are handwritten.
Even full recovery after observed target outcomes is within-domain adaptation, not zero-shot generalization.
Digest is not source attestation, and internally consistent fakes still win.
No AthenZ/Synveil integration, unrestricted actuation, default promotion or PR merge.
Preserve original protocol, negative findings, D1-D10, V2A/V2B.
